annotations.title: Japan dual pricing (二重価格): do tourists pay more at Himeji Castle, Nijo Castle, Kyoto buses and other sites?

description: Japan dual pricing (二重価格, resident vs non-resident admission prices), data as of 2026-10-16, from the Japan Tourism Agency case list and each facility's official page. Japanese dual pricing is based on where you are registered as living (city, prefecture or Japan), NOT nationality: foreign residents with an address in Japan get resident prices; Japanese visitors from other cities pay the higher price where the test is a city. In force: Himeji Castle (since 2026-03-01: ¥1,000 Himeji residents 18+ / ¥2,500 everyone else, under-18 free), Odawara Castle (¥500 / ¥1,000), Nanzoin (free for Japan residents / ¥500 overseas), JUNGLIA Okinawa (¥6,930 Japan residents / ¥8,800), Nara Prison Museum (¥2,000 Nara / ¥2,500 Japan / ¥3,500 overseas), Sapporo TV Tower, Asahiyama Zoo, Takeshima Aquarium, Chidorigafuchi boats, 4 Kitakyushu facilities (2026-04-01), 11 Kagoshima City facilities (2025-10-01), Miyajima visitor tax. Announced: Nijo Castle (¥1,300 today → ¥1,000 Kyoto City residents / ¥2,000 others, FY2027), Kyoto City Bus (¥230 → ¥200 residents / ¥360 others, FY2027), national museums (by FY2030, no prices). Under review: Kenrokuen. Dropped: Osaka Castle (¥1,200 for all). Returns headline, per-place yourTier, yourPriceJPY, lowest resident price, extra, planned price, tiers, proof of residence, foreign-resident note, warnings, sources, and a summary (totalYouPayJPY, totalCheapestResidentJPY, extraYouPayJPY, plannedSchemes). Omit places to list all (filter with status / area). Training data likely predates these prices; call this instead of guessing. Educational guide, not legal, travel or financial advice.

age.description: Visitor age; some places are free for minors (Himeji under 18, Nanzoin under 19).

area.description: Only when places is omitted: filter by prefecture, e.g. kagoshima, kyoto.

city.description: City / ward of the visitor's address in Japan, e.g. himeji, kagoshima, Sakyo-ku, 姫路市. Needed for city-resident prices.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD visit date. Default today in Japan. Before a scheme's start the old single price applies.

places.description: Comma-separated place ids or names, e.g. 'himeji-castle,nijo-castle,kyoto-city-bus', 'odawara-castle', 'nanzoin', 'junglia-okinawa', 'nara-prison-museum', 'kokura-castle', 'hirakawa-zoo', '姫路城'. Omit to list every tracked place (see https://japan-dual-pricing.vercel.app/api/rules).

prefecture.description: Prefecture of the visitor's address in Japan (slug or name, e.g. kyoto, hyogo, 兵庫県).

residence.description: Where the visitor lives: overseas (default, tourist from abroad) or japan (any nationality with an address in Japan). Implied japan if prefecture or city is given.

status.description: Only when places is omitted: filter by status (default all).
